description: A single-panel block diagram (schematic) of a nano-indentation apparatus, drawn as black-outlined rectangular boxes joined by arrowed signal lines on a white background. There are no axes, scale bars, numeric values or legend; every label is plain upper-case text. The diagram is laid out in three vertical columns. The left column, top to bottom, is VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR, SPM COMPUTER and SPM CONTROLLER. The right column is VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR, TRANSDUCER COMPUTER and TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER. The centre column is TRANSDUCER at the top, with two labelled arrows reading INDENTER TIP and SAMPLE that point at the tip–sample contact, then the 3-D PIEZO ACTUATOR box, which rests on top of the large box labelled MICROSCOPE PE, and finally SIGNAL ADAPTOR at the bottom. The arrows give the signal topology: SPM COMPUTER → VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR; SPM COMPUTER ↔ SPM CONTROLLER ↔ SIGNAL ADAPTOR; SIGNAL ADAPTOR ↔ MICROSCOPE PE; SIGNAL ADAPTOR → TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER; TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER → TRANSDUCER via a line routed up and left into the transducer box; and TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER ↔ TRANSDUCER COMPUTER → VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR. The figure demonstrates how the SPM/AFM control electronics and the separate transducer/indenter control electronics are interfaced through a signal adaptor around one shared microscope stage, i.e. how the indenter instrument is integrated with the AFM.

observations.observation: The figure is a system block diagram with three vertical columns of rectangular boxes: left = VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR, SPM COMPUTER, SPM CONTROLLER (top to bottom).

The centre column reads, top to bottom: TRANSDUCER (with arrows labelled INDENTER TIP and SAMPLE pointing at the tip–sample contact), 3-D PIEZO ACTUATOR, the large box labelled MICROSCOPE PE, and SIGNAL ADAPTOR.
The right column reads, top to bottom: VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR, TRANSDUCER COMPUTER, TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER.
The 3-D PIEZO ACTUATOR box sits directly on top of the MICROSCOPE PE box and supports the sample/tip stage, indicating the actuator is mounted on the microscope.
Signal arrows show SPM COMPUTER → VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR (upward) and SPM COMPUTER ↔ SPM CONTROLLER ↔ SIGNAL ADAPTOR (bidirectional vertical and horizontal links).
SIGNAL ADAPTOR is linked bidirectionally to MICROSCOPE PE above it and has a single-direction arrow pointing into TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER, so the adaptor bridges the SPM side and the transducer side.
A signal line runs from TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER up and to the left with its arrowhead entering the TRANSDUCER box, i.e. control/measurement goes to the transducer.
TRANSDUCER CONTROLLER is bidirectionally linked to TRANSDUCER COMPUTER, which drives a VIDEO DISPLAY MONITOR on the right.
No numeric values, axes, scale bars, magnification or legend appear anywhere in the diagram; only plain text block names are printed.
The caption states the figure is a schematic set-up of the nano-indentation apparatus.
The citing text states the indenter is a Triboscope (Hysitron Inc.) nano-indentation instrument set onto an AFM stage, SPM-9500J2 (Shimadzu Co.).
The citing text states the equipment specification is presented in Table 3; that table is not part of this figure and no specifications are visible in the diagram.
The block labelled MICROSCOPE PE is the only stage/microscope label in the diagram; the caption and citing text do not use that exact string, and no AFM model number is printed in the image.
